notes: Paths: realbugs/* and harness commands are relative to the fiks root; serverCommand, testCommand, installCommand, buildCommand, suiteScope, allowedEditPaths and humanFixTests are relative to the clone (repo root). {worktree} = a checked-out head of the clone; {sha} = prefix, fix or a commit in .work/realbugs/R20.

Everything from the clone runs only in the SBX per-repo image (packages/sandbox build.ts: pnpm repo, lockfile node_modules, --network none, HOME=/tmp). harness/server.ts builds dist with buildCommand (tsup without --dts; the package's own 'pnpm build' adds --dts, which takes ~2 min in the sandbox and changes no JS) and runs each case through harness/sandbox/case-runner.mjs in that container.

No base-URL env: the server hard-codes https://api.figma.com/v1 and downloads the S3 URLs the API returns, so baseUrlEnv is empty and the upstream is replayed through a loopback HTTPS CONNECT proxy in the container (HTTPS_PROXY, honoured by the server's undici EnvHttpProxyAgent; NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS = a throwaway CA from @fiks/replay-proc). FIGMA_API_KEY is passed as a CLI flag with a dummy value (the SBX backend refuses *API_KEY* env names); telemetry is off (--no-telemetry, DO_NOT_TRACK=1).

The contract property is a filesystem postcondition (kind fileWrittenRequested), evaluated by harness/check.ts evaluateCase over the listing of the case root the runner takes after the call, not by @fiks/contracts evaluate (see contract-log.md, vocabulary gap). A repro check module should call runHarness (or R20Sandbox.runCase + evaluateCase) on the trigger fixture and assert violations[].propertyId includes namedProperty.

suiteScope = the repo's tests that pass deterministically in the SBX image, offline. Excluded: src/tests/stdio.test.ts and src/tests/server.test.ts (each spawns 'tsx src/bin.ts'; cold tsx startup of the server takes ~80 s in the sandbox, so their 15 s / 30 s timeouts fail on both heads), src/tests/integration.test.ts (needs a real FIGMA_API_KEY and network; skipped without one).

humanFixTests pin the human fix's implementation (a new module src/utils/local-path.ts with resolveLocalPath/isWithin and its exact rejection reasons); a correct fix that writes absolute paths where asked without that module fails them on import. heldoutCommand is the direction-neutral oracle (write where asked, or refuse with isError).
allowedEditPaths: any TypeScript source under src/ (the bug spans the tool handler, src/utils/common.ts and possibly a new src/utils module), the repo's tests, and README.md.
